newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 107.2 Jan 17 wk.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 107.2 Jan 17 wk.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) weekly future inflation gauge (FIG) held steady at 107.2 in the week ended January 17 against a revised 107.2 the prior week, ECRI said.
Downward pressures during the week included a decrease in the growth rate of real estate loans and a narrowing of the yield spread between 10-year and three-month Treasuries, ECRI said.
Those were offset by an increase in the growth rate of industrial materials prices, it said.
"If the FIG continues to rise in the weeks and months ahead, it could very well portend higher inflation ahead," ECRI said.
